disclosures: Edition 01 was re-frozen on 5 October 2026, before launch, after an evidence review of every venue. No earlier version was announced.

Figures are DefiLlama's for the last complete day before the cut, counting only each venue's Robinhood Chain activity. Long.xyz and Factory New are not tracked there, so their figures show as not published.
Contract addresses come from DefiLlama's adapter source and Mobula's integration docs, and were checked on the Robinhood Chain explorer on 5 October 2026.
o1.exchange is on the watchlist: its launchpad is live on Robinhood Chain, but no stock pairing was found, so it is not admitted.
No venue paid for inclusion, placement or removal. There are no affiliate links in this edition.

venues.name: Long.xyz
venues.thesis: Every launch trades against a Robinhood Stock Token, never ETH. The strongest claim to a real share in the register.

rationale.asset: Every token is paired with a Robinhood Stock Token such as NVDA, TSLA or SPCX (MEXC Learn). Those tokens are derivatives issued by Robinhood Europe, UAB, backed by shares held in the US; holders cannot redeem for the share.
rationale.traction: Second-largest launchpad: about 25% of Robinhood Chain launchpad volume on 1 Sep 2026 (Bitget Academy) and about 20% of tokenized-stock TVL. Not tracked by DefiLlama, so no daily figure is published here.
rationale.transparency: LongLauncher and Airlock are verified on Blockscout and are not upgradeable. Its site and docs block automated checks, and only a co-founder is publicly named.
rationale.compliance: Leans on the issuer: Stock Tokens are issued under MiFID II by a Bank of Lithuania-regulated entity. The venue itself cites no licence.
rationale.durability: Live since Robinhood Chain mainnet in July 2026. Non-upgradeable core, but it depends on the shared Airlock and Uniswap v4.

pairing.custodian: Robinhood Europe, UAB (issuer); shares held at a US custodian via Alpaca Securities

facts: of Robinhood Chain launchpad volume on 1 Sep 2026 (Bitget Academy)

venues.name: Pons
venues.thesis: The busiest launchpad on the chain by far. Most launches pair with ETH; stock pairs are offered but are the minority.

rationale.asset: Launches trade against WETH by default (Bitget Academy). Stock-token pairs such as NVDA, AAPL and HOOD are available (AirdropAlert), so a real asset stands behind only part of the flow.
rationale.traction: Largest launchpad on the chain: about 60% of launchpad volume on 1 Sep 2026 (Bitget Academy) and $877K in fees on 4 Oct 2026 (DefiLlama).
rationale.transparency: PonsLaunchFactory, PonsLaunchLocker, PonsV2LaunchFactory and the v4 hook are verified and not upgradeable. Operated by Pons Labs. A legacy factory is unverified.
rationale.compliance: Launchpad terms only. No prospectus or licence cited. Protocol fees fund buybacks of its own PONS token.
rationale.durability: Live since early July 2026 and kept running through the chain disruption of 4 Sep 2026.

venues.name: StonkFun
venues.thesis: A Solana launchpad whose stock pairs use xStocks, tokens backed one to one by real shares in custody.

rationale.asset: Stock pairs use xStocks such as SPYx, issued by Backed Assets (JE) Ltd and backed 1:1 by shares at Alpaca Securities (Nansen). Memecoin holders get exposure, not a claim on the shares (Blocmates). It also pairs with crypto and its own tokens.
rationale.traction: About $10.1M daily volume and $298K fees on 3 Oct 2026, $807M cumulative (DefiLlama).
rationale.transparency: Tracked by DefiLlama with a public site. No operator is named and no program addresses have been checked here.
rationale.compliance: The xStocks issuer is registered in Jersey. The launchpad itself cites no licence. 60% of fees buy and burn its STONK token.
rationale.durability: Launched in early August 2026. Survived one hype cycle and integrated Raydium LaunchLab in September.

venues.name: Bankr
venues.thesis: An AI trading assistant that can quote launches in any of 90+ Stock Tokens. The stock pairing is optional.

rationale.asset: Since 20 Jul 2026 launches can be quoted in Robinhood Stock Tokens across 90+ equities and ETFs (Crypto Briefing), but stock pairing is optional.
rationale.traction: 97,058 of the 189,413 Doppler launches on Robinhood Chain by 30 Sep 2026 were Bankr's (DefiLlama adapter notes). Fees on the chain were $2.7K on 4 Oct 2026 (DefiLlama).
rationale.transparency: Named team, public docs, two audits listed on DefiLlama. Launches go through the shared Doppler contracts rather than its own.
rationale.compliance: No licence cited for stock-paired launches.
rationale.durability: Running on Base since 2025 and on Robinhood Chain since July 2026.

venues.name: PAIR
venues.thesis: Pairs each launch with a basket of up to five Robinhood Stock Tokens. Strong design, but trading has almost stopped.

rationale.asset: Every token trades from its first block against a basket of up to five canonical Robinhood Stock Tokens, in permanently locked Uniswap v4 markets (PAIR launch release).
rationale.traction: Passed $26M volume in its first five days after 26 Aug 2026, but fees were $9 on 4 Oct 2026 (DefiLlama).
rationale.transparency: Launchpad and v4 locker are verified on Blockscout. The launchpad is an upgradeable proxy, so its code can change.
rationale.compliance: Relies on the Stock Token issuer for regulated status. Announced an AWS partnership; no licence cited.
rationale.durability: Live since 26 Aug 2026 with an upgradeable core.

pairing.custodian: Robinhood Europe, UAB (issuer); shares held at a US custodian via Alpaca Securities

venues.name: Flap
venues.thesis: Pairs launches with a stock and pays that stock out to holders. Large on BNB Chain, small on Robinhood Chain.

rationale.asset: Its Stocks Vault pairs a memecoin with a tokenized stock and pays that stock to holders as dividends (AirdropAlert). Exposure, not ownership of the share.
rationale.traction: On Robinhood Chain: $13K volume and $2.6K fees on 4 Oct 2026, with $94K TVL (DefiLlama). Almost all its activity is on BNB Chain.
rationale.transparency: Its Robinhood Chain portal is verified on Blockscout but is an upgradeable proxy. Public docs.
rationale.durability: Running since January 2024 on BNB Chain, on Robinhood Chain since 8 Jul 2026.

venues.name: Pools.trade
venues.thesis: Uniswap Labs' own launchpad: the most transparent venue here, with no stock behind its pairs.

rationale.asset: Tokens launch into Uniswap v4 pools with a fixed supply of one billion (Uniswap). No stock-token pairing was found, so nothing real backs the pair.
rationale.traction: $6.9K fees on 4 Oct 2026 (DefiLlama). Live since 30 Jul 2026.
rationale.transparency: Built and named by Uniswap Labs, on Uniswap's verified UERC20Factory and PoolManager, with public support docs.
rationale.compliance: A known US company with published terms. It makes no securities claim because it pairs no securities.
rationale.durability: Runs on Uniswap's core contracts with permanently locked liquidity.

venues.name: Factory New
venues.thesis: Now a Solana memecoin launcher whose fees buy game skins for a public reserve. No stock anywhere.

rationale.asset: Fees buy CS2 and Dota 2 skins for a public Steam reserve (Factory New site). Collectibles, not stock, and the reserve is not tied to any single token.
rationale.traction: Not tracked by DefiLlama; no figure is published.
rationale.transparency: Public site describing the fee split. No operator named, no contracts checked.
rationale.durability: Has moved from Robinhood Chain to Solana. Too young to judge.

facts: trading fee, of which 2.5% buys skins (Factory New)
